# UW Department of Psychiatry

> Academic psychiatry department providing clinical care, training, and research across multiple specialties with emphasis on neuroscience, sleep medicine, and mental health innovation.

The UW Department of Psychiatry at the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health offers comprehensive psychiatric education through residency and fellowship programs, conducts cutting-edge research in neuroscience and consciousness, and maintains clinical services across Wisconsin. The department is committed to social impact and belonging in psychiatry.

## Key Topics

- Psychiatry Residency
- Fellowship Programs
- Clinical Training
- Psychiatric Research
- Addiction Psychiatry
- Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
- Geriatric Psychiatry
- Medical Education
- Neuroimaging
- Sleep Medicine
- Schizophrenia Research
- Anxiety Disorders
- Psychology Internship
- Parent-Infant Mental Health
- Social Impact & Belonging

## About the Department

- [UW Department of Psychiatry Homepage](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu): UW Department of Psychiatry homepage with department overview and crisis resources
- [Mission](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/mission): Department mission statement covering clinical care, research, and training
- [Faculty & Staff](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/faculty-staff): Faculty and staff directory with department leadership and organizational structure
- [Social Impact & Belonging](https://sib.psychiatry.wisc.edu): Social impact and belonging initiative promoting equity in research and patient care
- [Contact Us](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/contact-us): Contact information, clinical facilities, and crisis resources including 988 Lifeline

## Education & Training Programs

- [Education & Training Overview](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training): Overview of psychiatry education and training programs at UW-Madison
- [Psychiatry Residency](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training/residency): Psychiatry residency program overview with tracks and application information
- [Child & Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training/child-adolescent-psychiatry-fellowship): Two-year Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Fellowship program overview
- [Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training/addiction-psychiatry-fellowship): One-year Addiction Psychiatry Fellowship for substance use disorder training
- [Geriatric Psychiatry Fellowship](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training/geriatric-psychiatry): One-year Geriatric Psychiatry Fellowship with clinical training emphasis
- [Psychology Internship](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training/psychology-internship): APA-accredited Psychology Internship program with adult, child, and pediatric tracks
- [Medical Student Education](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training/medical-student-education): ForWard Curriculum medical student education in psychiatry clinical rotations
- [Continuing Medical Education](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/education-training/continuing-medical-education): CME opportunities including Grand Rounds, journal clubs, and seminars

## Research & Innovation

- [Research Overview](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/research): Research overview covering sleep, anxiety, schizophrenia, and consciousness studies
- [Labs & Researchers](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/research/researchers): Faculty researchers and labs in neuroscience, sleep, and mental health research
- [Lane Neuroimaging Lab](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/research/lane): Lane Neuroimaging Lab MRI research access and protocols for researchers
- [Parent-Infant and Early Childhood Mental Health](http://infantfamilymentalhealth.psychiatry.wisc.edu): Center for Innovations in Parent-Infant and Early Childhood Mental Health
- [Participate in Research](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/research/participate): Research participation opportunities and clinical trial recruitment information

## Careers & Support

- [Careers](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/careers): Job openings and career opportunities in psychiatry at UW-Madison
- [Give](https://www.psychiatry.wisc.edu/give): Donation and fundraising page for department research and programs
